gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-taviraj: Blunt and confident, that's Aaargh up top. Its heading letters keep stems and curves cut from one gauge of tubing, while Taviraj, a classic serif, brings a restrained, editorial difference between stem and joining stroke.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-uchen: Heavy-handed and proud, Aaargh makes its entrance first. Its round bowls never swell or taper anywhere, which leaves Uchen, a classic serif with understated thick-thin contrast, to add a dignified, refined tone underneath.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-cutive: Modern, geometric Arkhip floats its letters well apart without any thick-and-thin modulation. Cutive, a text serif, does the opposite job, with low contrast and wide tracking that give running lines a literary, refined hush.
